terms: there are ways to find out more
ledgerSearch.outcome: No recorded decision conflicts with the baseline. CTD-0041 names this section's promise explicitly in its evidence: Volume II says there are ways to learn more, and the manuscripts provide no consistent link, contact path, or repository. The baseline phrasing, there are ways to find out more, is restored, which keeps the promise exactly as the item recorded it. CTD-0055 requires unbuilt safeguards to read as requirements; the section lists the trust layer, identity sovereignty, the physiological-wallet design, the cryptographic architecture, and the governance system as work not yet done, which is the honest form and is restored intact. CTD-0003 is engaged by physiological-wallet, unchanged in both texts.

findings.summary: The five open problems lost their resumptive predicate and their definite articles, turning an inventory of named work into a compound noun phrase.

evidence.baseline: The trust layer, the identity-sovereignty implementation, the design of the physiological-wallet layer over the long term, the cryptographic architecture that holds the surveillance-resistance commitments, the governance system that prevents founder-permanence capture [mark] each of these is work being done now or work that needs to begin.
evidence.shipped: The trust layer, identity-sovereignty implementation, long-term physiological-wallet design, cryptographic architecture for surveillance resistance, and governance system that prevents founder-permanence capture each name work now under way or still needing to begin.

findings.diagnosis: Each of these is is a resumptive that lets five long items run and then delivers one predicate. Without it the reader must carry a pending verb across fifty words and then meet each name, which is a plural subject taking a singular-sounding verb and reads as a stumble. The five definite articles also matter in a recruitment section: the trust layer is a specific thing the book has described and a builder could take on, where trust layer is a category. And work being done now or work that needs to begin repeats work so the two states stay distinct, which is the sentence's practical content for someone deciding where to put their time.

findings.summary: The invitation lost the qualifiers that keep it modest and the phrasing that makes the book a decision aid rather than a pitch.

evidence.baseline: the project called Providence is being developed openly and is looking for collaborators ... the book has been written in part as the document that helps you decide whether this is the project you want to give your time to
evidence.shipped: Providence is being developed openly and seeks collaborators ... the book was written in part to help you decide whether this is the project you want to give your time to

findings.diagnosis: The project called Providence is the volume's standard way of naming it, holding the name at arm's length rather than treating it as a known entity, and it appears that way in the Prologue and Chapter Five. Is looking for collaborators is a state the project is in; seeks collaborators is an advertisement. And as the document that helps you decide names the book's role in the reader's decision, which is a more careful claim than to help you decide, because it concedes that the deciding is the reader's.

findings.summary: The refusal of a single-project answer lost its universal and its concession.

evidence.baseline: there is no version of the next civilization in which a single coordination infrastructure produced by a single team becomes the answer ... not only to the one its author happens to be building
evidence.shipped: no single coordination infrastructure produced by one team can become the answer to the next civilization ... not only the one its author is building

findings.diagnosis: There is no version of the next civilization in which is a claim about every possible future, and the doubled single, a single infrastructure by a single team, is what makes the refusal specific rather than modest. Happens to be building is the sentence's one piece of self-deprecation and it is doing real work in a section asking people to build something else: it concedes the author's project is contingent. Is building removes the concession.
